description: This table provides reference prices for GM-designed variants, not a universally available shopping list. A monster normally takes no more than two optional upgrades, each once, unless its entry permits otherwise.

upgrades.name: No Upgrade
upgrades.effect: Retain the creature's standard profile.

upgrades.name: +1 Wound
upgrades.effect: Increase a single Monster's maximum Wounds by 1.

upgrades.name: +1" Move
upgrades.effect: Increase Movement by 1".

upgrades.name: Improve Armor
upgrades.effect: Improve Armor by one step.

upgrades.name: Improve Evade
upgrades.effect: Improve Evade by one step.

upgrades.name: Specialized Ward 6+
upgrades.effect: Gain Ward 6+ against one specified Damage type.

upgrades.name: Broad Ward 6+
upgrades.effect: Gain Ward 6+ against all applicable Damage types.

upgrades.name: Accurate 1
upgrades.effect: Add Accurate 1 to one Attack profile, allowing up to one natural 1 to be rerolled.

upgrades.name: Tough 1
upgrades.effect: Gain Tough 1 when making Armor Saves.

upgrades.name: Critical 1
upgrades.effect: One selected Attack gains Critical 1 unconditionally, converting one failed Hit die after rerolls.

upgrades.name: +2 Attacks
upgrades.effect: Increase one Attack profile by two Attacks.

upgrades.name: +1 Damage
upgrades.effect: Increase one Attack profile's Damage by 1.

upgrades.name: Gain Impact 1
upgrades.effect: Gain printed Impact 1, adding one automatic Hit to the normal highest-die Impact.

upgrades.name: +1 Impact
upgrades.effect: Increase printed Impact X by 1, adding one Hit to the usual highest-die base.

upgrades.name: Flying
upgrades.effect: Ignore intervening terrain and Models during movement, finishing legally.

upgrades.name: Climber
upgrades.effect: Climb vertical terrain at normal movement cost.

upgrades.name: Aquatic
upgrades.effect: Ignore ordinary swimming penalties.

upgrades.name: Regeneration 1
upgrades.effect: Heal 1 at the beginning of each Round, subject to applicable weaknesses.

upgrades.name: Minor Ranged Attack
upgrades.effect: Gain one modest ranged Attack profile.

upgrades.name: Minor Command Ability
upgrades.effect: Learn one additional limited Command Ability. Requires its printed CP expenditure; Doctrine cards only if an applicable campaign/faction rule explicitly demands them.

restrictions: A Monster normally takes a maximum of two optional upgrades, each once, unless its entry states otherwise.
designNotes: Additional Damage and Attacks should be more expensive on high-output weapons. Flying, Wards, and Regeneration are particularly valuable on Monsters with many Wounds.
